summary_1line: Vyasa explains a worm’s rebirth through karmic progression across species and castes, guiding the transformed Kshatriya toward righteous duty to eventually attain Brahminhood.

image_candidates.scene_text: A tiny worm remains on a dusty road as a massive chariot wheel rolls over it while the sage Vyasa watches with serene knowledge.
A newly reborn Kshatriya prince bows with joined palms at the feet of the sage Vyasa in a forest hermitage.
Vyasa instructs the armored Kshatriya king in the wilderness, speaking of duty while animals gather peacefully nearby.
